  "reasons": [
    "A transaction between existing investors where the issuing company is not a party occurs in the secondary market.",
    "Option A correctly identifies the market as the secondary market and provides the accurate definition/reason.",
    "Options B, C, and D mischaracterise the market or attribute an incorrect justification."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Financial Markets",
  "syllabus_topic": "Capital market and its types (primary and secondary market)",

  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Meena buys existing shares from another investor, Arun, with no issuing company participation.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "The secondary market is where investors trade securities with other investors rather than with the issuer.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E2.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {

      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Trading between two individual investors is considered a primary market operation.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "The secondary market is where companies raise capital by issuing securities.",

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "The Secondary Market is a place where an investor can buy/sell shares or securities from another investor rather than the issuer.",
      "reason": "Accurately defines the secondary market and matches the stem scenario."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Primary market, because the transaction allows the company to raise capital through issue of securities",
      "premise_source": "stem",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "The company that originally issued the shares is not a party to this deal.",
      "reason": "The company is not issuing securities or raising capital in this trade."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Primary market",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "The Secondary Market is a place where an investor can buy/sell shares or securities from another investor rather than the issuer.",
      "reason": "Trading between investors defines the secondary market, not the primary market."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "because the company raises capital through issue of securities",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "One of the main objectives of the primary market is to allow companies to raise capital through the issuance of securities",
      "reason": "Raising capital via securities issuance is the function of the primary market."
    }
  ]
